markscheme.html:
a

- Earth emits infrared radiation (energy loss) to balance the energy absorbed [1 mark]
- In the long term, radiative equilibrium is maintained when absorbed = emitted [1 mark]

b

- Greenhouse gases absorb some of the outgoing infrared radiation [1 mark]
- They then re-radiate energy back toward the Earth's surface, raising the surface temperature [1 mark]

c

- Natural greenhouse gas: carbon dioxide, water vapor, or methane [1 mark]
- Human activity: burning fossil fuels , agriculture or cattle farming , deforestation [1 mark]
